turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing using a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at three thousand revolutions per minute with no toolholder fitted and record the RMS vibration velocity in millimeters per second. Repeat the measurement at maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits for this machine class.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing with a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder fitted and record the root mean square vibration velocity in millimetres per second. Repeat at the maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits for this machine class.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Accelerometer mounted and measurements taken at both speeds. I've recorded the vibration velocities and compared them to the ISO limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing with a flat washer stud or magnetic base. turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the vibration level below the alarm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Both readings are within acceptable range, well below the alarm threshold.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the bearing temperature within the rated operating limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The bearing housings are running hot. Front bearing is showing thirty-two degrees above ambient and the rear is at seventy-six degrees absolute.

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. We have a bearing overtemperature condition. Take the spindle offline immediately and escalate for cooling circuit check.
